propositions: Pandoc 3.6.1 corrupts code spans by escaping punctuation, deletes HTML comments, and rewrites comment terminators when arrows are substituted globally
A two-phase lexer must lock code fences, HTML comments, four-space blocks, and backtick spans before any text processing to prevent pandoc from corrupting protected content
ASCII tables must be wrapped once in {noformat} and preserved exactly byte-for-byte across rendering passes
Inline Jira markup ({{monospace}}, [label|target], {color:name}) must be classified as UNAMBIGUOUS to prevent re-rendering cycles when inside bullet points
Every code fragment extracted from source markdown must appear byte-identically in rendered output or that unit must fall back to original markdown unchanged
Five-pass idempotence must be verified with only two renders by proving the pure deterministic renderer reaches a fixed point after the first pass
